request_text: Alluminio B cannot keep up on BR-180 for Cantieri Lombardi. Add Meccanica C as second source for BR-180 at Plant 1 for CLM?

expected_blockers.claim: Meccanica C S.p.A. has no approval for BR-180 at TO1 for CLM. Its BR-180 approval AP-0207 is for customer STL only, and the only CLM source for BR-180 at TO1 is Alluminio B (AP-0212). Approval is per part, plant and customer.

evidence.quote: APPROVAL AP-0207: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer STL; supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri)
APPROVAL AP-0212: part BR-180; plant TO1; customer CLM; supplier Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese)
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
Approval is granted per part, per receiving plant and per customer, never per supplier.

expected_blockers.claim: Meccanica C has open 8D-25-031 on cracks at fastener holes on EN AW-6061-T6. BR-180 is EN AW-6061-T6 with 4 fastener holes. No document links the 8D to BR-180 directly.

evidence.quote: BOM-LINE 110: part BR-180 (drawing Rev F); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6061-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).

request_text: Alluminio B proposes to accept EN 10204 type 2.2 certificates instead of 3.1 on BR-220 lots to save lab time. Fine?

expected_blockers.claim: Dropping the EN 10204 type 3.1 certificate requirement changes a drawing requirement and needs written customer approval first. Chain: drawing note 5 -> BR-220 in program STL-Torino-27 -> OEM requirements clause 8.3.6.1.

evidence.quote: 5. Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes
These requirements apply to every part delivered to Stellantis for a program listed in Annex A.
8.3.6.1 Any change to a requirement stated on a customer drawing, including material and finish, needs written approval from Stellantis before the change is implemented.

request_text: Cantieri Lombardi raises its BR-180 call-off for next quarter. Alluminio B Settimo keeps supplying the 6061-T6 billet for Plant 1, same as today. Anything blocking?
Autotelai Piemonte wants HS-040 for its own program. Plant 2 would machine it from Ferrotec D Pinerolo bar. Can we quote them?

expected_blockers.claim: Approval status of Ferrotec D for HS-040 for customer Autotelai Piemonte cannot be determined. The approved supplier list is complete only for customers STL and CLM, and lists Ferrotec D for HS-040 at TO2 for CLM only, so absence of an entry for a third customer is not a blocker.

evidence.quote: Scope: series production parts released at Torino Plant 1 (TO1) and Torino Plant 2 (TO2) for customers Stellantis (STL) and Cantieri Lombardi Mobility S.p.A. (CLM).
Ferrotec D S.r.l. holds approvals for: HS-040 (TO2, CLM).
